topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: The house, with its weathered shingles and the garden overgrown, stands much as it did the last time we saw our grandmother. The air inside carries the faint scent of her lavender sachets, a silent echo of her presence. My sibling and I walk through room after room, the weight of memories settling around us. There’s a quietness in our steps, a mutual understanding that this place holds more than just bricks and beams. We’ve inherited more than a house; we’ve inherited a piece of our past, a tangible link to the stories woven into these walls. The task ahead is clear, yet the path we choose will be shaped by the delicate balance of letting go and holding on.
